rationale: UniCredit HU Pillar 3 / annual accounts DAM store is a recurring, machine-friendly entity-level disclosure feed.
Mortgage-bank report index is a sub-page of unicreditbank.hu already covered by the parent IR crawl.
Canonical URL is a single 2021 IFRS PDF; promote the /document/publications/ index instead of this artifact.
Separate host net.cib.hu publishing recurring GRI/CSRD reports for an unlisted subsidiary; standalone index.
Single stable page carrying KDB Bank's IFRS statements and Pillar 3 disclosures, no siblings on domain.
Only Hungarian disclosure surface for the Oberbank branch, incl. MNB decisions list; low volume but in-scope.
Cofidis HU document library gives dated versioned terms/pricing PDFs; weak but a genuine recurring producer.
e-beszamolo is the authoritative statutory filing registry and the fallback for entities publishing nothing.
MNB Aranykonyv gives structured entity-level balance sheet and P&L for all supervised HU credit institutions.
Company-register aggregator usable continuously as identity/alias resolver feeding e-beszamolo lookups.
OPTEN/Ceginfo normalise filed accounts but the useful feed is paid; a human must clear licensing first.
Single member detail page (tagId=34) subsumed by the Tagjaink directory covering the same domain.
Banking Association member register is the best one-off seed for enumerating every HU bank disclosure source.
Association annual/quarterly sector reports are a recurring aggregate-results channel between MNB releases.
Communique archive is a continuous channel for sector positions on regulation, fees and payments policy.
Association press-release archive gives the fastest sector-wide signal ahead of individual bank disclosures.
G&P journal is a recurring publication with quantitative work on HU bank profitability, payments and ATM economics.
Working-group directory is a static map of sector agenda and decision-makers; mine once, refresh rarely.
EN mirror is the same association site via a lang parameter; adds translation only, not new content.
Fintech Association member register seeds dozens of HU PSP/vendor sources no keyword search surfaces.
Recurring fintech ecosystem reports; the only consolidated view of non-bank payment players in HU.
Events page keeps producing speaker/sponsor rosters, a live indicator of vendors selling into HU banks.
Leasing association statistics are the authoritative recurring HU leasing-volume series by asset class and member.
Leasing association annual report is a recurring sector-narrative and member-volume disclosure.
Knowledge base republishes Eurotax/Datahouse datasets otherwise paywalled; standalone recurring index.
GVH decision database is a searchable, continuously updated source of bank/PSP merger and conduct detail.
Merger-control guidance page is a static gvh.hu section already covered by the decision-search source.
GVH annual report to Parliament is a recurring retrospective index of financial-services competition activity.
